:::{#def-rational-numbers}
#### Rational numbers

A **rational number**
[@wikipedia_rational_number]
is a number that can be written as a fraction $\frac{a}{b}$,
where $a$ and $b$ are integers (@def-integers) and $b \ne 0$.
The set of rational numbers is written $\mathbb{Q}$:

$$\mathbb{Q} \eqdef \cb{\frac{a}{b} : a \in \mathbb{Z},\ b \in \mathbb{Z},\ b \ne 0}$$

:::
